resolutionPlaceholder: Describe how the dispute was handled (required for audit).

startReview.title: Mark dispute under review
startReview.description: The dispute stays open while you investigate. Parties cannot accept delivery until the dispute is resolved or closed.

resolve.title: Resolve dispute
resolve.description: Marks the dispute resolved and completes the linked order using the same escrow logic as accepting delivery.

close.title: Close dispute (cancel order)
close.description: Closes the dispute and cancels the linked order with escrow refund rules matching a normal cancellation.
